utility.name: AI lab server
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description: Trains a lab's target machine learning model at build time from per-build parameters, serves it over a query-limited HTTP API as an unprivileged user, and provides the evaluators that Hackerbot runs to mark a student's work. Hidden test data and parameters are readable only by root. Based on material from the CyBOK-funded Security-of-AI project (Anglia Ruskin University).
